summary: Independent source and structural review supports the 88-record research inventory and the proposed data-only provenance. It is not approval to import stars, draw figures, reuse illustrations, or expose runtime content.

source_reviews.evidence: The IAU page states that 88 constellations and three-letter Latin-name abbreviations are recognised; its table supplies Latin names, abbreviations, English names, PDF charts, and TXT boundaries. It defines the boundaries as the IAU quantity and says stick figures are not formally defined.

Opened the pinned index. Its Serpens object is one CON modern Ser record with two line groups; line values are the reviewed HIP join values. The index also contains image references, but none are reused or approved here.

The pinned description separates licenses: text and data are CC BY-SA 4.0, while illustrations are Free Art License. This review accepts only the stated machine-readable data provenance, never illustration reuse.
Opened pinned HYG v4.1 documentation. It distinguishes database primary key id from Hipparcos field hip, sets RA/Dec epoch and equinox 2000.0, and states CC BY-SA 4.0 licensing.
Independently stream-read the pinned CSV: 119626 rows; all 710 unique Stellarium line HIP values occur in HYG hip, with zero missing.

structural_checks.internal_reconciliation: Every line polyline deduplicates to its stored unique_hip_ids; each HYG and project-subset partition recomputes to its record set; the global unions recompute to 710, 54, and 656 respectively.

russian_name_review.evidence: The IAU source attests Latin names, abbreviations, and English display names; it does not establish Russian names. The 88 Russian editorial names are nonempty and unique and retain one Serpens/Змея entry, but a Russian-language authority would be needed before presenting them as official nomenclature.
editorial_points_checked: Serpens is one Змея record despite its two components.
Hydrus is distinguished from Hydra as Южная Гидра versus Гидра.
Circinus and Pyxis remain distinct as Циркуль and Компас.

limitations_and_release_constraints: The 656 line HIP values absent from the current 56-row project subset have no local star positions; no coordinates or runtime import may be inferred from this research record.
IAU recognizes boundary areas, not a single official stick-figure geometry. Stellarium line work must remain labeled as a candidate visual convention.
Stellarium illustration assets have a separate Free Art License. No visual asset was checked, copied, or approved by this data-only review.

English display names in the research file are normalized labels (for example, the IAU table uses articles such as “The Princess”); only Latin names and abbreviations should be described as verbatim IAU nomenclature.
Russian names are editorial localizations, not fields verified against an IAU Russian-name authority.
review_scope: Read-only source review; no source article, star data, visual asset, runtime integration, test, or build was changed or approved.
